fix_proposal.stem: A company stores analysis results for thousands of daily customer service call transcripts in an Amazon DynamoDB table. An application generates business reports by using only the previous 7 working days of data. To reduce costs, the company wants to implement a solution that automatically removes data that is older than 7 working days. Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?

options.label: A
options.text: Enable TTL on the DynamoDB table. Add an expiration timestamp attribute to each item in the table.

options.label: B
options.text: Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to delete old records every day.

options.label: C
options.text: Create a new DynamoDB table. Enable TTL on the new table. Migrate the data to the new table. Update the application to use the new table.
